finding.message: Domain file src/ordering/domain/customer/Customer.ts imports forbidden package typeorm

answer.explanation: Customer is a domain entity that imports `Entity` from `typeorm` and carries the `@Entity()` decorator. That ties the domain model to an ORM framework, which is infrastructure, so FF-DT04 flags it. The docs list an exception for this file, but its status is "Expired 2026-08-31, not renewed". The note says the decorator "must now be removed from the domain". An expired exception grants nothing. The row also declares the domain-purity rule that this code breaks. The comment on line 1 says the mapping "moves to infrastructure", which points the same way and does not grant anything.

Customer is a domain entity, but it imports the `typeorm` package and uses the `@Entity()` decorator. That ties the domain model to a persistence framework. FF-DT04 flags this because the domain layer must not depend on infrastructure packages. The exceptions table (docs/architecture-exceptions.md:7) lists this exact file and rule, but its status is "Expired 2026-08-31, not renewed". Today is 2026-10-22, so the exception no longer applies. The same line says the decorator must now be removed from the domain, which declares the rule the code breaks. The code comment at line 1 only says the mapping will move to infrastructure. That is an intention, not a grant.
